The HWPX document automation task achieved a perfect success rate by passing the legacy pytest suite in a single iteration.
The execution resulted in a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76, with all tests passing in 4 minutes and 17 seconds. The test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite passed successfully using pytest version 7.4.4. While the current implementation is reusable, future iterations should verify if the judge_reward gap (0.76 vs 1.0) indicates missing edge cases or stylistic requirements not covered by the automated tests.
